FilteredProperties.Name: SPACIOUS ROOM IN CONTEMPORARY STYLE FLAT
FilteredProperties.Description:
Welcome to my place! I offer a large room in a renovated flat, with contemporary décor. The room is airy and spacious, with plenty of natural light and very comfortable.

Please read the listing info in full.

Located in a residential road, the flat is just 8 min walk from Queens Road Peckham station, on the Overground and mainline trains. There are several buses going to Town and Victoria. Peckham itself is a vibrant and fashionable area with plenty of cafes, bars and restaurants minutes away!

FilteredProperties.Name: Room with a view, shared flat,  central  Bankside
FilteredProperties.Description:
A luminous room in a modern 2 bedroom flat located in Central London.
Room has a great view, simply furnished with neutral minimal decor. There is a king size bed, a chair and a small table and clothing rail. The bathroom and kitchen are shared.
The bathroom is located next to the room.

FilteredProperties.Name: Quiet Comfortable Room in Fulham
FilteredProperties.Description: Munster Village is a colourful collection of shops & restaurants plus all amnities at the end of our quiet, safe street.  There are Thai, Italian, French & English restaurants to choose from plus antique shops to browse in & easy access to the centre

FilteredProperties.Name: Beautiful 1 bed apt in Queens Park
FilteredProperties.Description:
A beautiful, light-filled, mid-century design inspired apartment in an attractive modern apartment block with great views across London. Perfect for couples or for a business traveller wanting a place to stay within easy reach of town and the world famous Portobello market.

No parking permit available. Only on-street parking. See photo of parking restrictions in the gallery.

FilteredProperties.Name: Best Part of Town -Home from Home!
FilteredProperties.Description:
This is a beautiful bookish, sunny, happy home full of art, in a fab London area: Notting Hill. I live in it myself & only host when away so please check with me first before booking.
The space is compact: ideal for a family, a couple, or friends, who enjoy the Bohemian experience of stepping into someone's London life, & who want to be out exploring but have somewhere beautiful to enjoy breakfast or a relaxed evening. Enjoy a vibrant neighbourhood area close to the centre & with its own charm.

FilteredProperties.Name: Beautiful, Luxurious Art Deco  +private bathroom
FilteredProperties.Description: Enjoy a wonderful bedroom, beautiful view, and your own ensuite in this luxurious space!  This unique space is great for romance, a quick break, work adventures, or a great starting place for coming to live in London. We're in the heart of one of London's trendiest neighbourhoods!

FilteredProperties.Name: Cosy Double studio in Zone 2 Hammersmith (6)
Cosy Double studio in Zone 2 Hammersmith (1)
Cosy Double studio in Zone 2 Hammersmith (4)
Cosy Double studio in Zone 2 Hammersmith (3)
Dbl en suite @ Oval tube Sth London
FilteredProperties.Description:
In the words of a recent guest: 'The house is darling, and the room itself is lovely with its private shower. The neighborhood is close to so many interesting areas, and is a great jumping off point to embark from.
I highly recommend a stay here!'

FilteredProperties.Name: 2 bed/2 bath luxury flat with city view!
FilteredProperties.Description: The apartment is on the top floor of a portered building. From the apartment there are amazing views of both the city of London and the hills of the south.

FilteredProperties.Name: Bright single room in family home.
FilteredProperties.Description:
Small, bright, single room in family home, overlooking garden. In quiet road, conveniently close to buses & trains & to East Dulwich, Peckham & Camberwell shops, pubs and restaurants. Close to Kings College Hospital for those working there.
Toast, jam, muesli, fruit, milk, tea & real coffee provided. Please request gluten-free or dairy-free in advance.

FilteredProperties.Name: Bright spacious 2 bed in Islington
FilteredProperties.Description: A truly unique apartment with a large and bright living room with vaulted ceilings. Situated on the 1st floor of a 2-flat conversion in the heart of Islington, right behind Upper Street. The apartment has two large bedrooms each with a king size bed.

FilteredProperties.Name: Clerkenwell penthouse, huge terrace
FilteredProperties.Description: ""Best views in London - Far exceeded expectations - Fab bedroom suite with glorious terrace - incredibly quiet but so central - Trendiest hood - Walk to Covent Garden..."" share my home and have the best ever London experience.

FilteredProperties.Name: Maisonette in Central London Zone 1
FilteredProperties.Description:
Room with a single bed in a very nice and spacious maisonette with patio garden, 3 minutes walk from Damien Hirst Newport Street Gallery which and from the River Thames. My maisonette is situated on the south side of Lambeth Bridge, with easy access to the city and the transport links to Waterloo Station, the House of Parliament, the Tate Gallery,the War Museum and the London Eye.

The room is neat and cozy with an in-built closet. The house has a large living room, eat-in kitchen, a big office.

FilteredProperties.Name: Lovely, spacious  garden apartment.
FilteredProperties.Description: Awarded four stars by Visit Britain.  Beautiful,  very spacious  apartment in Fulham with  100ft garden on the Chelsea/Kensington border.   Free Parking.   Three minutes  to tube station, five minutes from supermarkets, restaurants.   Pubs nearby.  Central to tourist attractions.  Wimbledon Tennis Club not far by tube.

FilteredProperties.Name: Luxury En-suite Room near Tube and River
Flat in Islington
FilteredProperties.Description: My place is close to Highbury & Islington Tube., Angel Tube., Town Hall. My place is good for couples, solo adventurers and business travellers.

FilteredProperties.Name: modern self contained flat islington
FilteredProperties.Description:
FULLY SELF CONTAINED. A newly renovated, self contained studio space with separate kitchen, on Newington Green, completely private, spacious bedroom, en-suite shower and private kitchenette, with separate street entrance off private courtyard.

Modern fixtures and fittings throughout. Great cafes and restaurants excellent transport links right on the doorstep.

FilteredProperties.Name: Lovely east London ground floor apartment
FilteredProperties.Description:
A lovely little ground floor apartment, minutes to the Central line. Great restaurants, greats bars, minutes from Victoria Park, the famous Colombia flower market and 15 minutes from the Olympic village. A great little flat in a great little location. If you want to experience what East London has to offer, you couldn’t find a better place.

We are sorry to include a cleaning fee for the December period.

FilteredProperties.Name: Gorgeous Victorian Flat LONDON
FilteredProperties.Description:
This is a lovely first floor flat in a victorian house which was recently refurbrished.
It is located in a very quiet (closed) street in an elegant area (Highgate) near two underground stations in zone 2 and 3 in London. Very easy access to the centre (25minutes) with underground and 24/7 busses.
It is perfect for couples or professionals looking for a quiet place to work or rest or families on holidays. Living room has a double sofa bed so the flat can accomodate up to 4 people if needed.

FilteredProperties.Name: Lovely large room, Bethnal Green
FilteredProperties.Description: Lovely characterful room in a house belonging to an artist and a musician.

FilteredProperties.Name: Double Room (Unavailable for check in 9-11 July)
FilteredProperties.Description: One lovely bright double bedroom for one guest only in a quiet area 25 minutes by tube from central London.

FilteredProperties.Name: Limehouse London, Spacious Property
FilteredProperties.Description: A lovely centrally located apartment for those exploring London  With a nightly rate of £50, its a great place to stay whilst in the city. Just 2min walk to major underground links and a warm and friendly host, its ideal!!

FilteredProperties.Name: Clerkenwell double
FilteredProperties.Description: A large double bedroom in a quiet area, tucked away in an oh-so quiet part of Clerkenwell, but minutes away from everything the area has to offer.

FilteredProperties.Name: A double Room 5mins from King's College Hospital
FilteredProperties.Description: Calm sunny double room with a queen size bed and a soft mattress in a quiet Zone 2 period flatshare in Loughborough Junction between Denmark Hill and Brixton. A short walk to excellent transport links with easy access to the centre of London, West End & City. A vast range of bars restaurants and local amenities walking distance in nearby Camberwell and Brixton. Modern shared kitchen and bathroom.

FilteredProperties.Name: The Residential Suite Above Gallery
FilteredProperties.Description: Welcome to your sanctuary above an art gallery in the heart of Victoria Park Village. Surround yourself with artisan cafes, traditional pubs, and independent shops. Steps from bus stops and tube stops are just 10 minutes away. Walk to Broadway Market and Shoreditch and experience the local culture. Enjoy beautiful Victoria Park, featuring a boating lake, flourishing gardens and fabulous breakfast served lakeside. This is your opportunity to experience one of London's most desirable locations.

FilteredProperties.Name: Quiet Double Room - Good for walks
FilteredProperties.Description:
Bed & Breakfast - Quiet double room in comfortable modern house overlooking the Ham Meadow Lands, close to the River Thames, Richmond Park and Richmond Town Centre as well as Kew Gardens and Hampton Court Palace.
30mins from Heathrow and central London by train from Richmond station.
Easy free parking.
Several pubs and restaurants for every taste can be found near by in Richmond, Teddington and Kingston-upon-Thames.

FilteredProperties.Name: Sun filled 2-bedroom with gardens, Broadway Market
FilteredProperties.Description: You're invited to enjoy the perfect summer base for your family holiday in London, in the vibrant neighbourhood of Broadway Market and London Fields, Hackney in east London. You will experience the comfort and convenience of our bright, spacious home, which consists of two bedrooms, large open-plan living room and kitchen, and front and back gardens.

FilteredProperties.Name: MODERN Self-Contained ARCHITECT FLAT
FilteredProperties.Description: A modern, self contained flatlet near Newington Green. Ensuite shower room and private kitchen, accessed via your own private entrance off front courtyard lightwell on the street.

FilteredProperties.Name: Private ensuite room in Harringay
FilteredProperties.Description: A fantastic, spacious pad for staying in a convenient location with great links to central and other parts of London.

FilteredProperties.Name: Bright sunny apartment on garden square
FilteredProperties.Description: Entire bright two-bedroom apartment in central London (Zone One) in Chelsea very close to London's major sights and only a few minutes walk from Earls Court tube station.  The flat is very bright and sunny and has great views over the garden square.

FilteredProperties.Name: Notting Hill, next to Portobello Rd
FilteredProperties.Description: Our apartment is just off the Portobello Road where the Portobello Market happens every Friday and Saturday. It's an area full of restaurants and cafes where you can enjoy the mix of international cultures, with nearby tubes, parks and lots to do.

FilteredProperties.Name: 2 Bedroom London East End Apartment
FilteredProperties.Description: This is a terraced ground floor flat that was built in the 20s. Very typical of the terraced houses of London. It's located five minutes from the main road where you will find supermarkets, restaurants and local businesses. There is a local convenience store opposite, and its about 15 minutes by bus to the 2012 Olympic Park and Westfield Stratford shopping centre. The Excel is a short three minute ride by bus. From there you can get the Elizabeth Line direct to Heathrow or the centre of town.

FilteredProperties.Name: Great location, direct links to London Bridge!
FilteredProperties.Description: This is a lovely two double bed apartment located in Forest Hill and within a minute to the the Train Station. This station has trains running every 4 minutes and takes you into London Bridge in 13 Minutes.

FilteredProperties.Name: 2 Bedroom  Cottage (E) with garden London
FilteredProperties.Description: Lovely 2 bed house with garden is perfectly located for easy access to all of London's attractions. 10 mins walk to underground and 20 minutes to the City by tube. Close to Heathrow airport.

FilteredProperties.Name: Architect designed Camden canalside townhouse
FilteredProperties.Description: A unique and spacious canal side townhouse designed by award winning architect, Sir Nicholas Grimshaw.  Cool, quirky, quiet yet minutes from the buzz of Camden.

FilteredProperties.Name: Amazing view 2bed Zone1 central
FilteredProperties.Description:
Non smoking apartment worth uk£600k (US$900k) with amazing views over the city of london that are to die for you can see st paul's cathedral, the shard, the gherkin, walkie talkie tower and canary wharf.
2 bedrooms with 1 king size bed and 1 double bed and 1 fold out John Lewis mattress
Please note due to apartment being zone 1 and it's proximity to fantastic transport links of 2 different underground lines and multiple bus routes and train line this isn't for people looking for quiet location

FilteredProperties.Name: Double room no 1 near Brunel, Uxbridge, Heathrow
FilteredProperties.Description: Double Bedroom equipped with free Tea/ Coffee and clean towels. The bathroom is also equipped with toiletries.

FilteredProperties.Name: London, Ace Family Friendly House, Hackney, Zone 2
FilteredProperties.Description: 5 bedroom family home in the heart of Stoke Newington, seconds from Church Street. The area is a quirky, vibrant village in Central London, Zone 2. Our house is a family home filled with all of our treasured possessions.

FilteredProperties.Name: peaceful double room 5mins from King's Hospital
FilteredProperties.Description:
A good size room in a very quiet 5 person flatshare in Loughborough Junction, between Denmark Hill and Brixton, close to Kings Hospital. Ideal for a quiet single person who wants a desk or a small couple. Excellent transport links to central London.

You are welcome to come home late at night if you do so quietly, mindful of our neighbours and other guests who may have to get up early in the morning for work!

FilteredProperties.Name: Pretty Home Kensal Green NW10 1 bed
FilteredProperties.Description: Bright First Floor 1 bed flat with private roof terrace with views over north London based in Kensal Green NW10.

FilteredProperties.Name: Double Room by Camden Market
FilteredProperties.Description: Great room in house right next to Camden Stables Market. There are two rooms available in the house.

FilteredProperties.Description:

Sharing with other guests, two Shared Bathrooms & Shared Kitchen.

Children & Infants are welcome but are counted as a guest.

Checkin from 12-1pm /Checkout 10am
Self Checkin Available with pre-arranged (with Front Door Entry Code)
Early Luggage Drop-off available from 8am & Luggage storage available on day of checkout.

FilteredProperties.Name: Superior Boutique Comfort, Amazing Fast Transport
FilteredProperties.Description: The largest room in the house, with two (double-glazed) windows. Two shared bathrooms between three rooms. Fastest fibre optic broadband  (wifi) included. Most useful accessories provided so you don't have to bring them.

FilteredProperties.Name: Beautiful warehouse flat in London
FilteredProperties.Description: This is an artist's live-in Studio space in an original old East London factory building located in the heart of Dalston, which has become one of the trendiest and liveliest areas in London over the past few years.

FilteredProperties.Name: Shepherds Bush W12 Double/Twin Room
FilteredProperties.Description: The apartment is a ground floor two bedroom apartment with a small garden - which is part of a Victorian Terrace house - it is located in very quiet -tree lined residential street. It is surrounded by transport lines - 4 tube stations..a bus station and an overground train station...which gives fast and easy access to central London. It also makes transit to all 4 of London's major airports! Shepherds Bush is a vibrant neighbourhood - with a mix of restaurants, music venues and shopping....

FilteredProperties.Name: Homely Triple Room London 2
FilteredProperties.Description: Breakfast is included in the price.

FilteredProperties.Name: 1 bed flat near city.
FilteredProperties.Description:
Located in N1 makes this the perfect flat for a business or pleasure trip to London. Kitted out with everything you could need for your stay, down to the tin opener and towels!

Available for short term stays, but I'm now looking for a long term let, so keen to hear from you if you're looking for a year's contract.

Nestled between the uber cool Angel Islington on one side and The City district on the other, but far enough away to be peaceful, this funky one bed flat is the perfect escape.

FilteredProperties.Name: Cosy Room in Balham. Female only
Gorgeous double at Camden Market
FilteredProperties.Description: This fine property in the heart of Camden Town / Chalk Farm combines the traditional Georgian townhouse with sleek and modern design, great for open plan living. This cool house is a calm antidote to the hustle and bustle of London life.

FilteredProperties.Name: Beautiful one-bedroom flat in Hackney
FilteredProperties.Description: Beautiful architect-owned flat between London Fields/Broadway Market and Victoria Park. 4m high ceilings and roof terrace!  Easy access to central London; parks and markets nearby, great restaurants, cafes, bars etc.

FilteredProperties.Name: Bright airy double room, central
FilteredProperties.Description: The bright airy private room is in a shared flat ,with a fully equipped kitchen and shared bathroom . It overlooks a beautiful park and is an ideal location for sightseeing  and local bars and restaurants. It is a very peaceful location to recharge your batteries and cook a meal if desired.

FilteredProperties.Name: Sunny Victorian Flat in London
FilteredProperties.Description: Beautiful 2 bedroom flat in Tooting Broadway, perfect base for anyone wishing to explore London, Wimbledon and the South Coast - I would love to welcome you into my home :-)

FilteredProperties.Name: Large sunny room, private bathroom, Dalston
FilteredProperties.Description: Our characterful Victorian home is located in a quiet residential street on the edge of Dalston and Stoke Newington, two interesting areas. It's a great neighbourhood to be based in for a London visit with numerous transport links into the centre of London.  The room is light and spacious with it's own ensuite. We have a extensive knowlege of London and can offer lots of advice on where to go and what to do, to help you get the most from your stay.

FilteredProperties.Name: Earls Court-London-2 Bed/2 Bath
FilteredProperties.Description:
Two bedroom apartment , each bedroom has a comfortable queen size bed that sleeps 2 in each bedroom.
The neighbourhood is safe and quite which is located on a quite tree lined street with hardly any traffic.
We are also 3 minutes away from Earls Court tube station zone 1.

FilteredProperties.Name: Stunning Bright flat
FilteredProperties.Description: A gorgeous one bedroom first floor flat in the heart of Camden Town. The perfect combination of the comfort of a home on the doorstep of the quiet and atmospheric Regent's canal and 6 min walk from the vibrant Camden Town High Street.

FilteredProperties.Name: Large Dble Bdrm TV/Wifi nr NPL & St Mary's Uni
FilteredProperties.Description: Just read the reviews, have been an Airbnb host for over 12 years, friendly and fun place to stay. Hundreds of great guests have stayed over the past years and it has been great meeting and hosting them all.

FilteredProperties.Name: Heart of Notting Hill Garden Flat + cats
FilteredProperties.Description:
4 min walk to world famous Portobello Road market and Notting Hill's blue door.

Tube: Westbourne Park 7min, Notting Hill Gate 14min. Heathrow 50min.

Subletting my home for summer holidays 4-24 August. Any questions just ask.

FilteredProperties.Name: Stylish Ensuite Room in house. - Maida Vale.
FilteredProperties.Description:
GUEST ROOM:

Spacious double bedroom available in our modern 3 bedroom house. The room has a king size bed and plenty of storage space (double wardrobe and draw space). The room has an en-suite WC and shower. Towels and bed linen are provided. The room also has a CD player and radio alarm. It can accommodate a single guest or a couple.

AMENITIES:

- Wifi internet
- Bed linen and towels provided
- Kitchen with washing machine
- Family/child friendly
- Central heating

TRANSPORT:

- 5 mins walk to Maida Vale Underground
- 2 min from local bus stop, with buses that go to Marble Arch, Victoria and Oxford Street. Journeys take a maximum of 10 minutes.

LOCATION:

We live on a quiet cobbled street in affluent area. There is a variety of restaurants offering different cuisines. There are also the usual high street shops and supermarkets, like M&S, Tesco and Boots Pharmacy.

FilteredProperties.Name: Cozy room in lovely area!(Chiswick)
FilteredProperties.Description: Double bedroom and private bathroom in family house.

FilteredProperties.Name: Lovely Twin Room near to Common
FilteredProperties.Description:
Welcome to my pretty twin room in lovely Wimbledon village. From Wimbledon station the centre of London is just 20 minutes away.
Enjoy a relaxing continental breakfast before you set out on your planned activities.

FilteredProperties.Description:
This room is very quiet, cosy and spacious, and it has a desk for laptop working. It is perfect for either 1 or 2 people, but it’s also a home-from-home for a parent travelling with a child.

Battersea Park, a range of pubs and restaurants, a leisure centre and all kinds of public transport (including Boris Bikes) are available nearby.

FilteredProperties.Name: Sunny single free WiFi  Nr Richmond
FilteredProperties.Description:
Single room in a 3 storey house on a quiet residential road. Easy walking to Richmond on river towpath. Richmond has a wealth of restaurants, pubs, three cinemas and many attractions: Richmond Park , Ham House, river cruises and rowing boats/boards/bicycles for hire. Hampton Court Palace can be reached by bus or boat.

Richmond has the underground/overground/ regular trains taking 10 minutes into Central London.

Richmond also boasts boat yards still repairing and building wooden boats.

FilteredProperties.Name: Pimlico Pad
FilteredProperties.Description: A double bedded room with compact en suite shower room, in a quiet part of the house. Shared with a male couple in their double bedded room with private facilities. Comfortable lounge and kitchen diner, with wi-fi, flat screen TV and all other mod con

FilteredProperties.Name: garden studio Ealing sleep up to 4
FilteredProperties.Description:
THE FLAT IS JUST 13 MINUTES WALK (or 1 mins. bus ride) FROM THE ELIZABETH LINE which takes you, in just 10 minutes, into the central tourist district of London, directly and with no change.
15 mins ride from Heathrow airport. Excellent transport network.
This clean and bright studio flat has own completely private front door access, and rear door to a quiet private garden.
The flat is part of Art Deco building. It is 35 square meters large. It is modern furnished and is nicely decorated.

FilteredProperties.Description: Gin

FilteredProperties.Name: Super small double in stunning home
FilteredProperties.Description: Please message me before making a reservation.  This is my home where I live and some exchange of information is useful.  Please note that check-in is between 12am and 10pm  unless by prior arrangement.

FilteredProperties.Name: Cosy and central St Luke's/Barbican single room
FilteredProperties.Description: Are you working, studying, or exploring London on your own? Looking for somewhere grown-up, comfy, relaxed and central to stay? Great transport links, arts all around you, a street market and a low-key, friendly neighbourhood vibe help make St Luke's feel like home from home. Nothing luxurious, just a great fuss-free base to use and a Londoner (me!) to help you make the most of it all. Any questions, just get in touch.

FilteredProperties.Name: DYNAMITE views!
FilteredProperties.Description: Large one bedroom flat on the third floor of a quiet five story building with lots of light, space and security. Centrally located near fashionable Brick Lane/Shoreditch, and 25 minutes from Oxford Circus, the flat offers everything a visitor seeks.

FilteredProperties.Name: Entire quiet spacious home
FilteredProperties.Description: An apartment on the same Underground line as Heathrow Airport, one stop from St Pancras International train station. Separate kitchen and lounge. Includes strong Wifi, iMac, hairdryer, power adapters. Read the reviews!

FilteredProperties.Name: Bright Rooftop Nest In Notting Hill
FilteredProperties.Description: A pretty, modern flat for 1-3 guests nestled among the rooftops on Chepstow Road,  a perfect London location. There is easy acces to all of central London and a five minute walk from the world famous bustling 'Portobello Road'.

FilteredProperties.Name: Room in Stoke Newington by Church Street and park
FilteredProperties.Description:
Private double bedroom in a flat in fashionable Stoke Newington. Me and my partner Mark live in the flat too. You're welcome to share our living room and kitchen, and we're happy to show you around.

The location is amazing. We're just a couple of minutes walk from Church Street, which is packed with restaurants, bars, and shops. Just around the corner is the beautiful Clissold Park. Manor House underground and Stoke Newington train station are 15 mins walk away.

FilteredProperties.Name: Lovely 2 bedroom flat near Brixton, zone 2, London
FilteredProperties.Description:
Modern, luminous flat located between Brixton and Camberwell in London, zone 2. The flat has 2 double bedrooms, living room, kitchen, 1 bathroom with bath tub (which is ensuite to the main bedroom), 1 toilet with shower, 1 single sofa bed and all mod cons.
** Kindly note the price in the title is for the first 2 people, there's a supplement of £ 5 per person per night for the 3rd, 4th and 5th person staying

FilteredProperties.Name: Boutique Room w/ Private Bath, Balcony
FilteredProperties.Description: Our modern, elegant, central apartment is part of a stylish development on a pedestrianised square in the vibrant and thriving artistic and hipster community of Dalston on the borders of Hackney and Islington - there are colourful East London markets (Broadway Market, Columbia Flower Market), amazing cafes and restaurants, quick transport connections to all the tourist sights of London. We are located just across from Dalston Junction station to ensure your comfort and safety night & day.

FilteredProperties.Name: Large double bedroom in Shoreditch w/garden
FilteredProperties.Description: Tasteful quiet bedroom in a beautiful house with a secret garden, right in the centre of Shoreditch. Hoxton square, Regents canal, London Fields, Broadway Market, Columbia Road...Nothing is more than a 10 minute walk away.

FilteredProperties.Name: Double Room and Workspace in spacious Garden Flat
FilteredProperties.Description:
Bright room with queen size double bed, workspace and ample storage. The flat is in a Victorian terrace near Newington Green, Canonbury, Dalston and De Beauvoir, in the Mildmay Conservation Area. There are several reasonably priced cafes, restaurants and food stores nearby.

Clissold Park is a short bus ride away, and Newington Green (a small park with cafe) is at the end of the road.

There are good bus and tube links to central London, main line train stations, Eurostar & London airports.

FilteredProperties.Name: London, Ealing, W13 Artists Home
FilteredProperties.Description: Our unique comfortable vibrant 1904 Edwardian home is well placed to provide everything you need for your trip:- Excellent transport links into Central London & Heathrow Airport,  bars & restaurants, quiet green spaces, shopping, art, sport; it's all here in a safe environment, with a quiet, restful, extremely safe space of your own when you need to sleep!

FilteredProperties.Name: Attic Room in historic Greenwich
FilteredProperties.Description: The room does not have a door but its own discreet staircase. It is light, airy and open plan. The leaning ceiling provides  a snug hideaway feel and  benefits from a fine panoramic view of London.

FilteredProperties.Name: 202 double room shower Soho comfy
FilteredProperties.Description: A simple double bedroom with private ensuite shower/toilet in heart of London's Soho/China Town.

FilteredProperties.Name: Spacious Double/Triple near Common
FilteredProperties.Description: Large room with double and single bed in the historic village of Wimbledon. Suitable for short stays and guests with planned activities during the day.

FilteredProperties.Description:
Spacious large Semi-detachted Maisonette, a 100 years old maisonette! Very comfortable!
Off street car parking outside apartment.
Flat comprises TV sitting room/lounge. Excellent WiFi connection.

FilteredProperties.Name: Cosy single room in Finchley
FilteredProperties.Description: Nice room in suburban house.  Free parking. Pleasant garden. Situated in North Finchley close to Friern Barnet and not far from East Finchley, Muswell Hill and Whetstone.   There is a park nearby.
